newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures dip at close, seen sideways.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures dip at close, seen sideways.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures ended slightly off after failing to sustain early gains on Monday and dealers said the market was likely to trade sideways in the absence of fresh factors.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 March contract lost 25 points to finish at 18,725 after hitting an early high of 18,865. Volume was a relatively low 12,460 lots.
A trader with a local institution said the March Nikkei was likely to be bought on any dips towards the 18,450-18,550 area, but it needed to close above at least 18,750 to head higher.
"There could be a possible pullback to 18,200-18,300 before it goes much higher," he said.
"There's tough resistance above 18,900. If it takes that out, it can go to 19,100," he added.
"Some people are expecting a breach of the 19,000-mark some time this week. Sentiment is turning from bearish to bullish," said another trader.
The March MSCI Taiwan stock index contract closed at 324.5 against its opening 321.5 on volume of 231 lots.
